dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.criteria: Two dumbbells, hip-width planted stance, slightly bent knees kept consistent; hips hinge backward with neutral trunk; stop at a comfortable stretch and return upright.

dumbbell-stiff-leg-deadlift.criteria: Two dumbbells; nearly straight but unlocked knees remain fixed while hinging at hips. Keep back neutral, limit descent to comfortable hamstring stretch, return without leaning backward.

b-stance-romanian-deadlift.criteria: Two dumbbells, staggered kickstand stance, rear heel raised with toe support, primary support from front leg. Hip hinge with level pelvis and slightly bent working knee; repeat then switch sides.
